name: What design considerations are important for custom home renovations?

mainEntity.name: What design considerations are important for custom home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key design considerations for custom home renovations include functionality, aesthetics, budget, and future needs. Think about how you use each space and what improvements would enhance daily living. Consider your preferred style, material durability, and energy efficiency. It's also wise to factor in potential resale value and how the renovation will integrate with your home's existing architecture. Our designers help blend these elements into a cohesive plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Important design considerations include functionality, aesthetics, budget, future needs, material durability, energy efficiency, and how the renovation integrates with existing architecture.
